What is your role at Dallas Detox Center? What does that look like day to day?

I am a Case Manager. My day-to-day can vary quite a bit (which I actually like), but I help clients with the things going on outside of treatment, whether that’s legal, probation/parole, FMLA and short term disability, and a long list of other issues. My job is to help them handle that outside stuff so that they can be fully present and focused on what’s most important: their recovery. I’m also a fan of the 12 Steps, so if clients have questions about, or want to get started on the 12 Steps, I’m here to assist with that as well.
